value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a named, vertex-transitive cubic Klein-bottle map graph and the smallest nontrivial six-crossed prism example. Its ordinary independence polynomial was known, but that does not distinguish integral generators or the full 48-symmetry homology module. Here a single geometric orbit of eight induced octahedral 2-spheres integrally generates rank four while the other twelve-member orbit spans only rank three, and four explicit cycles give a primitive basis and nontrivial integral automorphism matrices. These are natural geometric, action-sensitive invariants with plausible use in crossed-prism and symmetry quotient calculations, beyond Betti-number recomputation or an arbitrary slice. The claim does not pretend to classify the entire family.
